source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of design for accessibility (PDF 190).

blocks.text: Accessibility ke liye design karne ka matlab hai digital content ko har shakhs ke liye qabil-e-istemal banana, maazoor afraad samait. (Kitab ne neeche misalon ko bhi alag number, 2 aur 4, de diye hain; yahan har misal apne point ke saath hai.)

items: Readable Fonts (aasani se parhe jane wale fonts): Saaf aur bare fonts istemal karein jo aasani se parhe ja sakein. Misal: Arial ya Times New Roman jaise fonts chunein aur bohat zyada sajawati (decorative) styles se bachein.

Alternative Text for Images (tasveeron ka mutabadil text): Tasveeron ki tafseel (description) likhein ta ke visually impaired (nazar ki kamzori wale) users bhi content samajh sakein; screen reader yeh text parh kar suna deta hai. Misal: Report mein charts ya graphs ke saath un ki tafseel likhein.

blocks.prompt: Accessible digital content ka tasawwur samjhaiye aur maazoor afraad ki digital shamooliyat (inclusivity) ki tadabeer bataiye. (Long question 5)
blocks.explanation: Accessible content woh hai jo har koi, maazoor afraad samait, istemal kar sake (7.6.5). Kitab ki tadabeer: 1) Saaf aur bare fonts, jaise Arial ya Times New Roman, sajawati styles nahi. 2) Tasveeron, charts aur graphs ka alternative text, ta ke nazar ki kamzori wale samajh sakein. 3) User feedback: surveys aur forms aur users se seedhi baat (7.6.5.2), ta ke pata chale kya theek karna hai. Mazeed aam tareeqe (hamare, kitab ke nahi): rangon ka wazeh farq (contrast), videos ke captions ya transcripts, screen reader ke liye saaf headings, sirf keyboard se bhi chalne wala content, aur saada zaban.

items: Accessibility design: readable fonts (Arial, Times New Roman), images ka alternative text (charts aur graphs ki tafseel).
